svg.title: Flower Anatomy Drag & Drop
svg.desc: A static, script-free SVG learning activity. Learners match ten word-bank tiles (petal, sepal, stamen, pistil, anther, filament, ovary, style, stigma, receptacle) to numbered slots on a longitudinal-section flower diagram. Hint, Check Answer and Reset open popup panels using internal anchor links and the CSS :target selector; the pollination inset can be enlarged with an SVG view (viewBox shift).

g.text: Biology, Unit 4: Plant reproduction. Label the parts of a flowering plant.
Ten structures are marked on Figure 1. Match each
Word Bank tile to the numbered slot it belongs in.
Follow each arrow to the part it points at.
Click a Word Bank tile to lift it off the tray.
Match it to a glowing slot and note your answer.
Stuck? Hint shows a clue for every slot.
Reveal the key and score yourself out of 10.
Pollen lands on a sticky stigma.
It grows down through the style.
Sperm fuses with an egg in the ovule.
The ovule becomes a seed; the ovary, a fruit.

text.tspan: Click a tile to pick it up, then match it to a numbered slot.

g.text: Tile picked up. Drop it onto one of the glowing slots.
A clue for each numbered slot. The names are yours to find.
A tiny pouch at the tip of a stalk. It makes and stores pollen.
The sticky landing pad at the very top of the female organ.
Large and colorful; it advertises the flower to pollinators.
Pink dashed ring: the complete female organ, built from three parts.
A slender stalk that lifts the pollen sac up into the air.
The long neck linking the landing pad to the swollen base.
The swollen chamber holding ovules. It ripens into the fruit.
Blue dashed ring: the complete male organ, a stalk plus a pollen sac.
Small green “leaves” that wrapped and protected the flower bud.
The thickened stem tip where every other flower part is attached.
Stamen sounds like “stay-men”: it is the male organ (anther on a filament).
Read the pistil from the top down: stigma, then style, then ovary.
Hints describe each part’s job, never its name.
Answer key shown. Compare it with your choices.
Every slot now shows its correct label.
Give yourself one point for each tile you matched.
Under 5? Review the hints, then reset and try again.
All 10 tiles are back on the tray and every slot is empty.
Take a fresh look at Figure 1 and try again.
